dangerous_cpts.main_problem: The same deterministic entry is repeatedly flagged across multiple suspicious paths and appears only in failures. This suggests the hard OR gate at the no-lung/no-tub configuration may be too rigid for the observed cases and may be suppressing downstream disease evidence.

suspicious_parameters.justification: This parameter is the most recurrent suspicious entry in the report, appearing on all suspicious paths with failure-only activation. A small increase from zero would relax the deterministic exclusion of either=yes when lung=no and tub=no, which is the most directly implicated local mechanism.

cpt_danger_report.overall_summary: Only the either CPT is sufficiently well supported for refinement at the requested priority level. Other flagged parameters are either semantically plausible with weaker evidence or may mainly reflect upstream effects rather than their own CPT assignments.
